title: Headscale
author: Headscale authors
description: Headscale is an open source, self-hosted implementation of the Tailscale control server. This Cloudron package runs Headscale with SQLite storage, an optional embedded DERP STUN UDP port, and a bundled web UI protected by Cloudron proxy auth.
postInstallMessage: Headscale is ready. Open Configure for the Cloudron-protected UI. Use Enrollment keys to add a machine and copy its key immediately. The optional Tailscale gateway is disabled until configured; choose services and limits before enabling it. DERP is optional and disabled by default.

DERP_PORT.title: DERP STUN Port
DERP_PORT.description: UDP port for embedded DERP STUN (optional)
